paper.title: Learning 4D Geometric Priors for Inference-Efficient World Action Models
paper.source_path: /Users/roywangj/journey_wj/research/papers4zotero/zotero1/storage/VFAT5V4G/Zhang 等 - 2026 - Learning 4D Geometric Priors for Inference-Efficient World Action Models.pdf

blocks.original_text: Abstract: WAMs jointly model visual future dynamics and executable action sequences; MECo-WAM adds training-only action-relevant 4D priors.
blocks.translation: 摘要：WAM 联合建模视觉未来动态和可执行动作序列；MECo-WAM 加入仅训练期的动作相关四维先验。

blocks.original_text: Robotic manipulation requires mapping visual observations and instructions to action trajectories.
blocks.translation: 机器人操作需要将视觉观测和指令映射为动作轨迹。

blocks.original_text: Appearance-oriented video prediction may not preserve evolving spatial relations required for manipulation.
blocks.translation: 面向外观的视频预测可能无法保留操作需要的演化空间关系。

blocks.original_text: Explicit deployment-time 4D geometry raises cost and generic supervision can miss action-relevant relations.
blocks.translation: 部署期显式四维几何会提高成本，通用监督可能遗漏动作相关关系。

blocks.original_text: MECo-WAM learns action-relevant temporal geometry in training while retaining a lightweight deployment graph.
blocks.translation: MECo-WAM 在训练中学习动作相关时序几何，同时保留轻量级部署图。

blocks.original_text: Decayed 4D read-mask attention and action-aware temporal geometric distillation transfer geometry without permanent dependency.
blocks.translation: 衰减式四维读掩码注意力和动作感知时序几何蒸馏在不形成永久依赖时传递几何知识。

blocks.original_text: Four stated contributions: MECo-WAM, decayed read mask, action-aware distillation, and empirical gains.
blocks.translation: 四项声明贡献：MECo-WAM、衰减读掩码、动作感知蒸馏及实证增益。

blocks.original_text: World action models combine policy learning and world modeling.
blocks.translation: 世界动作模型结合策略学习和世界建模。

blocks.original_text: Fast-WAM retains useful training video prediction but omits explicit future imagination during action inference.
blocks.translation: Fast-WAM 保留有用的训练期视频预测，但动作推理不显式进行未来想象。

blocks.original_text: Geometry-aware VLA models inject 3D structure through several representation forms.
blocks.translation: 几何感知 VLA 模型通过多种表征形式注入三维结构。

blocks.original_text: MECo-WAM uses frozen VGGT geometry as a training-time representation constraint instead of deployment-time reconstruction.
blocks.translation: MECo-WAM 将冻结 VGGT 几何作为训练期表征约束，而非部署期重建。

blocks.original_text: Problem formulation defines o0, a0, language instruction l, and action chunk a1:H.
blocks.translation: 问题形式化定义 o0、a0、语言指令 l 及动作块 a1:H。
部署策略的条件概率模型。（公式保持不译）

blocks.original_text: The auxiliary 4D expert constrains shared representation through relational losses.
blocks.translation: 辅助四维专家通过关系损失约束共享表征。

blocks.original_text: 4D geometry is a training-time representation constraint, and auxiliary components are removed at deployment.
blocks.translation: 四维几何是训练期表征约束；部署时移除辅助组件。

blocks.original_text: Video expert noise-slot construction.
blocks.translation: 视频专家的噪声槽位构造。

blocks.original_text: Video denoising construction and E_v prediction. (2)
blocks.translation: 视频去噪构造和 E_v 预测。（公式保持不译）

blocks.original_text: Action expert uses a0 as a clean anchor and uses the same noise-slot convention.
blocks.translation: 动作专家将 a0 作为干净锚点，并使用相同噪声槽位约定。

blocks.original_text: Action denoising construction and E_a prediction. (3)
blocks.translation: 动作去噪构造和 E_a 预测。（公式保持不译）

blocks.original_text: 4D expert obtains tokens from frozen VGGT; current geometry is clean and future slots are noisy.
blocks.translation: 四维专家从冻结 VGGT 获得令牌；当前几何干净，未来槽位带噪。

blocks.original_text: 4D denoising construction and E_4d prediction. (4)
blocks.translation: 四维去噪构造和 E_4d 预测。（公式保持不译）

blocks.original_text: 4D objective applies only to selected keyframes.
blocks.translation: 四维目标只应用于选定关键帧。

blocks.original_text: Selected predicted and clean geometry keyframe sets. (5)
blocks.translation: 选定预测与干净几何关键帧集合。（公式保持不译）

blocks.original_text: Mixed attention concatenates video, action, and 4D sequences with separate expert projections.
blocks.translation: 混合注意力拼接视频、动作与四维序列，并使用独立专家投影。

blocks.original_text: Decayed read-mask attention prevents future-information shortcuts and temporarily reads g0.
blocks.translation: 衰减读掩码注意力防止未来信息捷径，并临时读取 g0。

blocks.original_text: The g0 read edges are stochastic and decay over optimization.
blocks.translation: g0 读取边是随机的，并随优化衰减。

blocks.original_text: The activation probability follows a linear decay; at deployment p_end=0.
blocks.translation: 激活概率线性衰减；部署时 p_end=0。

blocks.original_text: Distillation combines relation matching, action-aware weights, and temporal relation matching.
blocks.translation: 蒸馏结合关系匹配、动作感知权重和时序关系匹配。

blocks.original_text: VGGT-aligned geometry uses normalized pairwise feature relations.
blocks.translation: VGGT 对齐几何使用归一化成对特征关系。

blocks.original_text: Action-aware relevance is mixed with a uniform prior to avoid collapse.
blocks.translation: 动作感知相关性与均匀先验混合以避免塌缩。

blocks.original_text: Within-frame and temporal losses match action-weighted relative geometry and its changes.
blocks.translation: 帧内和时序损失匹配动作加权的相对几何及其变化。

blocks.original_text: Base WAM uses conditional flow matching for video and actions.
blocks.translation: 基础 WAM 对视频和动作使用条件流匹配。

blocks.original_text: Total loss combines video, action, and 4D losses; geometry components are removed at inference.
blocks.translation: 总损失结合视频、动作与四维损失；推理时移除几何组件。

blocks.original_text: Implementation details: Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, 1B action expert, 0.45B auxiliary 4D expert, frozen VGGT-1B.
blocks.translation: 实现细节：Wan2.2-TI2V-5B、10 亿参数动作专家、4.5 亿参数辅助四维专家、冻结 VGGT-1B。

blocks.original_text: Training uses 33 robot steps, H=32, nine video frames, continuous flow matching and 64 H20 GPUs.
blocks.translation: 训练采用 33 个机器人步、H=32、9 个视频帧、连续流匹配和 64 张 H20 GPU。

blocks.original_text: Experiments cover LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world tabletop manipulation.
blocks.translation: 实验涵盖 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 和真实桌面操作。

blocks.original_text: MECo-WAM reaches 98.2% average success on LIBERO without policy pretraining.
blocks.translation: MECo-WAM 未经策略预训练即在 LIBERO 达到 98.2% 平均成功率。

blocks.original_text: MECo-WAM reaches 92.62% RoboTwin average versus Fast-WAM 91.83%.
blocks.translation: MECo-WAM 在 RoboTwin 的平均值为 92.62%，Fast-WAM 为 91.83%。

blocks.original_text: Real-world MECo-WAM reduces corrections/time and improves size sorting metrics.
blocks.translation: 真实世界中，MECo-WAM 减少纠正／时间并改善尺寸排序指标。

blocks.original_text: Depth and grasp probes exclude 4D tokens and indicate transfer to deployed features.
blocks.translation: 深度与抓取探测排除了四维令牌，表明先验已迁移至部署特征。

blocks.original_text: Ablations show decayed read and relation losses are necessary for best results.
blocks.translation: 消融显示，衰减读取和关系损失是获得最佳结果的必要组成。

blocks.original_text: Conclusion: training-only 4D supervision improves geometry reasoning without deployment cost.
blocks.translation: 结论：仅训练期四维监督提升几何推理而不增加部署成本。
